mapper.insert: INSERT INTO futuresim_plan_snapshot ( user_id, plan_name, goal_amount, goal_preset_key, benchmark_type, benchmark_label, benchmark_median_net_worth, assumed_return_rate, selected_levers_json, baseline_months_to_goal, projected_months_to_goal, diff_months, loan_impact_json, final_net_worth ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{planName}, #{goalAmount}, #{goalPresetKey}, #{benchmarkType}, #{benchmarkLabel}, #{benchmarkMedianNetWorth}, #{assumedReturnRate}, #{selectedLeversJson}, #{baselineMonthsToGoal}, #{projectedMonthsToGoal}, #{diffMonths}, #{loanImpactJson}, #{finalNetWorth} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE goal_amount = VALUES(goal_amount), goal_preset_key = VALUES(goal_preset_key), benchmark_type = VALUES(benchmark_type), benchmark_label = VALUES(benchmark_label), benchmark_median_net_worth = VALUES(benchmark_median_net_worth), assumed_return_rate = VALUES(assumed_return_rate), selected_levers_json = VALUES(selected_levers_json), baseline_months_to_goal = VALUES(baseline_months_to_goal), projected_months_to_goal = VALUES(projected_months_to_goal), diff_months = VALUES(diff_months), loan_impact_json = VALUES(loan_impact_json), final_net_worth = VALUES(final_net_worth)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM futuresim_plan_snapshot WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
